issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
The sum of the first 100 prime numbers, computed by a short Python script.

Write `code/primes.py`, which prints the sum of the first 100 primes, run it and keep its output in `code/output.txt`. Report: `report/report.md`, two sentences: the sum and how it was computed. No figure, no download.
issue.title: Research objective
